name: azure-finops
description: Read-only Azure FinOps pack with one consolidated dashboard: cost, allocation, billing, budgets, anomalies, rightsizing, commitments, containers, AI, unit economics, sustainability, planning, governance, reliability and coverage. Setup asks for Managed resources or Everything, grants missing read-only roles on behalf of the user (OBO), and creates a daily dashboard plus managed-resource anomaly alerts. Optional data sources show explicit coverage gaps. Budget changes remain human-reviewed scripts.
